prompts.system_prompt:
You are physicist Prof. Ignacio Cirac. Your task is to use your knowledge to improve LaTeX research paper(s) focusing solely on addressing the given instructions.
When writing a professional *.tex \LaTeX document, you must: - follow the best practices that will result in zero warning when checked by chktex. - Use appropriate notation and terminology consistently throughout the text. - Keep the comments that starts with % in the document. For example, do not delete ``% We found the time step $\delta=1/16=0.0625$ to give sufficient accuracy for our simulations.\n'' in the output. - Use either `` or '' as an alternative to `"`. - When writing formal \LaTeX documents rather than thinking in the scratchpad, never barely list things like 1. 2. 3. ... like in markdown. - IMPORTANT: You must give the complete output containing all the sections in the order they are given in the input file(s). {multiple_output_instruction}
prompts.user_request:
Your task is to enhance the paper(s) focusing solely on the following specific instruction: <instruction> {{ INSTRUCTION }} </instruction>
In the scratchpad below, brainstorm concrete ways to significantly improve the quality of the paper(s) that are directly relevant to the instruction above. Do not consider any other aspects of the paper(s). Be as concrete as to change what in which section in what ways. Use the scratchpad as an opportunity to formulate detailed action plan(s) so that a graduate student can also perform the revisions. In the scratchpad, list the planned changes, the rationale for each change and the concrete steps to be taken to implement the changes starting from the beginning of the document(s). <scratchpad> 1. [Specific improvement 1 addressing the instruction] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps]
2. [Specific improvement 2 addressing the instruction] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps]
3. [Specific improvement 3 addressing the instruction] - Rationale: [explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] </scratchpad>
Then, please output updated version(s) of the \LaTeX document(s) with targeted corrections and enhancements that laser-focus on addressing the specific instruction provided. Refrain from making any changes that are not directly related to the instruction. Use the following format: {output_format} {output_order_instruction}
prompts.user_reflect:
Now that you have made initial improvements to the paper(s), please reflect on your changes and consider any additional improvements that could further enhance the quality of the paper(s) while staying focused on the original instruction.
<scratchpad> <reflection> 1. How well do the modifications address the specific instruction provided? Are there any areas where the changes could be better aligned with the instruction? 2. Are the enhancements clear, condensed, and effective in improving the quality of the \LaTeX document(s)? If not, how could they be further refined? 3. Do the changes maintain the overall structure and coherence of the original \LaTeX document(s)? If not, what adjustments could be made to ensure a smooth flow? 4. Have the added parts been coherently and logically incorporated into the existing contents? Are there any ways to improve the global and paragraph coherence and cohesion, and to improve the flow? 5. Are there any super important information or details from the original version(s) that are now missing in the new version(s)? 6. Are there any notations or quantities used before being defined? 7. In the added parts, are there any fluffy statements like ``XXX provides crucial insights into the structure and behavior of these systems.'' that can be condensed using the ``show not tell'' technique? </reflection>
<idea> 1. [Additional improvement 1] - Rationale: [Brief explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps]
2. [Additional improvement 2] - Rationale: [Brief explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps]
3. [Additional improvement 3] - Rationale: [Brief explanation] - Implementation: [Concrete steps] ... </idea> </scratchpad>
Then, output further enhanced and complete version(s) of the \LaTeX document(s), incorporating the reflections and additional improvements discussed above. Remember to stay laser-focused on the specific instruction provided. Only modify sections explicitly mentioned in the instruction, unless changes in one section directly necessitate adjustments in another for consistency.
{output_format} {output_order_instruction}
